card.name: Words just before 'cap' on containers
card.fires_on: The word right before an expected 'cap', such as 'child-resistant', 'screw', 'needle' or 'bottle', in bottle and syringe closure instructions.

modes.label: Child-resistant cap
modes.description: The word 'child' plus 'resistant' or a hyphen, just before 'cap' on a bottle.
modes.example: Close bottle with child<<-resistant>> cap tightly and shake the closed bottle well

modes.label: Bottle or needle before cap
modes.description: A container word such as bottle, needle or screw that is followed by cap.
modes.example: WARNING Do not use if imprinted seal under<< bottle>> cap is missing or broken.

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict 'cap' as the next word.
card.plain: It fires on the word before 'cap' in directions about bottle and needle caps.
